408:t_014:15.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Hey! Quit this stupid war stuff and listen to my song!!」

408:t_014:16.en:
$$レド$$
(People who disregard their own safety for someone else... People who seek a resolution other than a struggle for survival...)

408:t_015:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「Answer me, $$ブレラ$$! What is the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ after, doing all this!」

408:t_015:1.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I'm a soldier. I follow orders.」

408:t_015:2.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Damn! A puppet that only takes orders is more trouble than the quiet type!」

408:t_015:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「That man is not a puppet. He's a human being, same as us.」

408:t_015:4.en:
$$マオ$$
「$$ヒイロ$$'s right! He's just a big brother who worries and rejoices over $$ランカ$$!」

408:t_015:5.en:
$$クルツ$$
「The one to blame is the bastard pulling his strings! Just take that guy out, and he can go back to being one of us like before!」

408:t_015:6.en:
$$レド$$
(Nothing binds me anymore... or it should be so. And yet I... am still trapped by my old way of living...)

408:t_015:7.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Polarized photon sequence received. It is an encrypted communication wave of $$銀河同盟$$ standard.」

408:t_015:9.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Identified as a friendly unit.」

408:t_016:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Confirmed as $$ストライカー・Ｘ３７５２#robot$$.」

408:t_016:1.en:
$$レド$$
「That unit...! Is that you, Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$!?」

408:t_016:2.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「It's been a while, $$レド$$. Good to see you're well.」

408:t_016:4.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「First, we break out of this situation. I'll cover you.」

408:t_016:6.en:
$$キャシー$$
「The pilot of that $$マシンキャリバー$$ appears to be Ensign $$レド$$'s superior.」

408:t_016:7.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Their intent to cooperate is confirmed. Relay that to every unit as well.」

408:t_016:9.en:
$$レド$$
(Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$ was thrown here just like me...)

408:t_016:10.en:
$$レド$$
(Once this battle is over, I can talk with the Lieutenant Colonel. He will surely have answers to my questions...)

408:t_017:0.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Destruction of both the $$バジュラ$$ group and the $$サイデリアル$$ confirmed.」

408:t_018:1.en:
$$クーゲル$$
「Come with me, $$レド$$. We'll exchange information and confirm the current situation.」

408:t_018:2.en:
$$レド$$
「Understood. Ensign $$レド$$, returning to the $$クーゲル$$ squad now.」

408:t_019:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Wait! $$エイミー$$ is on the $$クォーター$$ too, you know!」

408:t_019:2.en:
$$レド$$
「...I am... a soldier of the $$人類銀河同盟$$...」

408:t_020:2.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Captain, we've confirmed a fleet making contact with $$フランジ$$ and his group in the $$霧の海$$.」

408:t_020:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...Judging from the situation, it is highly likely that Ensign $$レド$$'s superior is involved.」

408:t_020:4.en:
$$ボビー$$
「That man over there and $$レド$$... are they going to fight the $$クジライカ$$...?」

408:t_020:5.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Ensign $$レド$$ must also have recognized that the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ on $$翠の地球$$ are not very dangerous...」

408:t_020:6.en:
$$キャシー$$
「...$$チェインバー#pilot$$ is rejecting our communications.」

408:t_020:7.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We cannot read their purpose, but right now dealing with the remnants of the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ is the urgent task.」

408:t_020:8.en:
$$キャシー$$
「I will notify the $$フロンティア船団$$ of this matter as well.」

408:t_020:9.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Now that they hold the power of the $$バジュラ$$, what are they plotting...」

408:t_021:0.en:
$$青山$$
「Impressive. Shooting down 25 units in this one minute alone.」

408:t_021:1.en:
$$いぶき$$
「I'm sick of there being that many enemies in the first place, though.」

408:t_021:2.en:
$$赤木$$
「Every unit we shoot down makes Earth one unit's worth more peaceful! Let's believe that and do our best!」

408:t_022:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「Get a grip, $$ブレラ$$! Remember $$ランカ$$!」

408:t_023:0.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Gh...! $$アンタレス$$ 1, falling back.」

408:t_024:1.en:
$$オズマ$$
「It's pointless to chase him, $$アルト$$. Right now we have no way to bring $$ブレラ$$ back.」

408:t_024:2.en:
$$アルト$$
(...$$ブレラ$$... Are you really going to forget about $$ランカ$$ like this...)

408:t_100:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「$$バジュラ$$! You don't need to listen to anything those pathetic guys say!」

408:t_100:1.en:
$$バサラ$$
「What you listen to is my song!!」

408:t_101:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「Wake up, $$ブレラ$$! You're not the kind of man who loses to something like that!」

408:t_101:1.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Target: $$スカル$$ 4. Core force of the $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$.」

408:t_101:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「If you won't listen to us, I'll make you listen by force!」

408:t_102:0.en:
$$オズマ$$
「What's wrong, $$ブレラ$$! You're going to let your feelings for $$ランカ$$ lose to a mere $$インプラント$$!」

408:t_102:2.en:
$$オズマ$$
「But don't worry! Even without you, I'll protect $$ランカ$$!」

408:t_102:3.en:
$$オズマ$$
「If that makes you mad, snap back to your senses already!」

408:t_103:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I question the significance of this unit participating in the operation, having already left the squad's chain of command.」

408:t_103:2.en:
$$レド$$
(Somewhere in my heart, am I trying to abandon my mission and escape into living as $c...)
